name: James son of Alphaeus
title: James the Less
summary: James son of Alphaeus, also known as 'James the Less' or 'James the Younger', was one of Jesus' twelve apostles. He is distinguished from James son of Zebedee by his father Alphaeus. He is mentioned in all the lists of apostles, but little else is known about his life and ministry.

keyEvents.title: Chosen as an Apostle
keyEvents.description: James son of Alphaeus was chosen as one of Jesus' twelve apostles and is mentioned in the lists of apostles in all four Gospels.

keyEvents.title: Among the Apostles
keyEvents.description: James is listed among the twelve whom Jesus gave authority to drive out unclean spirits and heal diseases.

keyEvents.title: Sent Out
keyEvents.description: James was among the twelve whom Jesus sent out two by two to preach and heal.

keyEvents.title: In the Upper Room
keyEvents.description: After the ascension, James son of Alphaeus was among the apostles who gathered together in prayer in the upper room in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: At the Cross
keyEvents.description: His mother Mary was among the women who stood by Jesus' cross and witnessed the crucifixion.
